title: Context as Infrastructure: Knowledge Compilation for Retrieval in Agentic Systems with Harnesses
title_zh: 上下文即基础设施：基于测试框架的智能体检索系统中的知识编译

paragraphs.en: 提出知识编译作为智能体检索的供给层，显著减少token消耗与延迟，并开源RAGFlow流水线与测试框架。 Retrieval-augmented generation is becoming agentic. A search harness writes queries, reads results, reformulates, and decides when to stop. This largely solves accuracy: a harness with only BM25/grep and MiniMax M3 answers 85% of BrowseComp-Plus and 91% on multi-hop FRAMES in our runs, without compiled or vector indexes. It exposes a context problem: an undisciplined loop repeats queries, rereads documents, and fills the window with unused passages. The missing layer is knowledge compilation: a configurable ingestion pipeline where LLMs enrich documents with context no chunk contains alone--navigation hierarchies with claim-evidence leaves, entity graphs, timelines, mind maps, ontologies, wikis, and memory. Compilation is not a better retriever: under a competent harness, structural artifacts gave no detectable accuracy gain on FRAMES, and a PageIndex-style outline degraded at scale. It is a supply layer. A navigation tree whose leaves are claim-evidence pairs--the mechanism we measure--cuts query tokens by 91% when evidence suffices and adds 1.9% when it does not, a 38% average reduction; this implies a 2% break-even sufficiency rate and a measured rate near 43%. A decision gate cuts latency from 140 s to 30 s, though substitution's token saving is bought with retrieval rounds and carries its own latency cost. Other artifacts--ontology, graph, wiki, timeline, mind map, memory--pay off in deployment (governance, integration, onboarding, temporal orientation, continuity) where accuracy benchmarks cannot see them. We describe RAGFlow's pipeline and harness (open source at https://github.com/infiniflow/ragflow), which turns the loop into five disciplined stations and keeps the context entering the model the smallest sufficient set; together they form an agent-native database: a store that hands the agent compiled, governed context instead of a ranked list of passages.
paragraphs.zh: 提出将知识编译作为智能体检索的供给层，显著减少token消耗与延迟，并开源RAGFlow流水线与测试框架。检索增强生成正在走向智能体化。 一个搜索框架会撰写查询、阅读结果、重新表述，并决定何时停止。 这在很大程度上解决了准确性问题：在我们的实验中，一个仅使用BM25/grep和MiniMax M3的框架，无需编译索引或向量索引，即可在BrowseComp-Plus上达到85%的准确率，在多跳FRAMES上达到91%。 它暴露了一个上下文问题：不受约束的循环会重复查询、反复阅读文档，并用未使用的段落填满上下文窗口。 缺失的层次是知识编译：一个可配置的摄取流水线，让LLM为文档补充任何单独的文本块都无法包含的上下文——带主张-证据叶节点的导航层级、实体图谱、时间线、思维导图、本体、维基和记忆。 编译并不是一个更好的检索器：在一个能力足够的框架下，结构化工件在FRAMES上没有带来可检测的准确性提升，而PageIndex式的大纲在规模扩大时反而退化。它是一个供给层。 叶节点为主张-证据对的导航树——即我们所测量的机制——在证据充分时将查询token削减91%，在证据不充分时增加1.9%，平均降低38%；这意味着2%的盈亏平衡充分率，而实测充分率接近43%。 一个决策门可将延迟从140秒降至30秒，不过替代机制虽然节省了token，却以检索轮数为代价，并带来其自身的延迟成本。 其他工件——本体、图谱、维基、时间线、思维导图、记忆——在部署中发挥作用（治理、集成、入职引导、时间定位、连续性），而准确性基准测试无法看到这些价值。 我们描述了RAGFlow的流水线与框架（开源地址：https://github.com/infiniflow/ragflow），它把这个循环变成五个规范化的站点，并使进入模型的上下文保持为最小的充分集合；二者共同构成一个智能体原生数据库：一个向智能体交付经过编译和治理的上下文，而非段落排序列表的存储。
